description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
* Facilitate real-time communication between English and Mandarin speakers via audio or video calls.
* Provide interpretation services across various industries, including healthcare, education, insurance, banking, and emergency services (911).
* Handle sensitive topics such as medical emergencies, accidents, violence, criminal matters, and other situations requiring strong mental resilience.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
* Interpret conversations accurately between speakers with different accents, speaking speeds, and communication styles.
* Provide clear and accurate interpretation of questions, answers, statements, and other verbal communications.
* Translate written materials when required.
* Complete daily activity logs and documentation.
* Comply with applicable professional ethics and standards.
requirements_text:
1. Internet Connection
* Cable-Modem or Fiber Optic WiFi (No mobile data).
* Download speed > 5 Mbps
* Upload speed > 3 Mbps
* Ping < 50 ms
* Jitter < 30 ms
2. Laptop/iPad (Own Device)
Required for assessments, training, and operations.
* Windows 11 version 23H2
* macOS 12 or above
* ChromeOS (latest version)
* Updated antivirus and browser (No Kaspersky products).
3. Mobile Phone (Own Device)
Required as a backup for operations.
* Android 13+ or iOS 16+
* Not supported: Huawei, Samsung A Series, iPads/Tablets, iPhone 6 and below.
